games.title: Hogwarts Legacy
games.summary: An immersive, open-world action RPG set in the world first introduced in the Harry Potter books. Take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.
games.notes: Physical Xbox One copy. Back case lists single player, 4K Ultra HD, HDR10, Dolby Atmos, 3D Spatial Sound, and in-game purchases.
games.seriesXEnhancements: 4K Ultra HD; HDR10; Dolby Atmos; 3D Spatial Sound
